tasks.description: Allow an admin to delete a car from the catalog. The deletion should remove the car permanently from the database and update the UI accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can select a car from the catalog
Admin can click the delete button to initiate removal
System prompts for confirmation; car is NOT deleted if Admin cancels
Car is permanently removed from the database upon confirmation
Admin receives a success notification after deletion
UI handles errors gracefully if database deletion fails
